verdict.rationale: The evidence shows autonomous multi-step workflows that a user invokes as one-off actions: /autoplan runs its review skills with auto-decisions, /qa iteratively fixes bugs, and /ship runs a release pipeline. Nothing documents setting up automations that run in the background on a schedule, trigger, or recurring basis. The persistent headless Chromium daemon, the GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE setting and end-of-session learning logging are adjacent infrastructure, not user-configurable background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
